name: no-ai-slop
tagline_zh: 嫌自己写的像ChatGPT？它专挑空话套话和端水句式下手，改完还是你的口气，不是机器味。
tagline_en: Tired of sounding like ChatGPT? It strips clichés and hedge-words, keeping your tone—not a robot's.
desc_en: Edit drafts into sharper, more human writing while preserving the writer's personal voice, or detect AI-slop patterns without rewriting. Use when the user wants a draft clearer, more direct, more opinionated, or less AI-sounding, or asks whether writing reads as AI.
why_zh: 不是套模板重写，而是先识别AI高频腔调（如“总之”“值得注意的是”），再按你的原句节奏做微创手术。
why_en: No template rewrite—it detects AI tells like 'in conclusion' or 'notably,' then surgically edits around your original rhythm.
limit_zh: 只处理文本，不读上下文背景；若原文信息密度过低，它只能删词无法补料；对诗歌、俳句等文体不适用，会误伤修辞。
limit_en: Text-only, no context reading. If source is info-sparse, it trims words but can't add substance. Not for poetry/haiku—will mangle metaphor.
title_en: De-AI your drafts, keep your voice
